spec.default: Show as a key/value metadata head above the title in the label style; never hidden, never rewritten; unknown keys shown
spec.range: reader may collapse it to one line
spec.why: Header decides when an instruction file applies (4 of 4 formats read)

spec.default: A notice in the existing notices region names each removed element/comment with count, with a summoned list and jump to Source range
spec.why: Silence about removal shows a document that is not the one the agent obeys

spec.default: Keep children; show tag name as inline label (needs sanitiser decision); never remove with contents
spec.why: Tags are the agent's structure and the content of the prompt
spec.marxyToday: contradicted — policy.ts removes unknown elements with contents; renders or vanishes depending on blank lines

spec.default: Do not fold what the author did not fold; a fenced tool result stays a fence
spec.why: Rendered mode shows the author's markdown
spec.marxyToday: applied — details is transparent so it renders open (fold state not kept)

spec.setting: Derived transcript: tool call at rest
spec.default: One line (verb, target, outcome); result over 30 lines shown as first 10 + last 10 with omitted count as text; one disclosure level; copy always takes the whole source (30 and 10/10 are author judgement; VS Code 30 is a scroll-height limit, Codex CLI shows 5 lines)
spec.why: VS Code 30-line default; 1 of 3 tools read gives a number; Nielsen two-level limit

spec.default: Outdented label text per turn (you / agent / tool), message at 66-char measure, 30px between exchanges and 15px within; colour never carries speaker
spec.marxyToday: open — no turn or role node in ast.ts

spec.default: Every task item is a checkbox including those starting with a code span
spec.why: Agent plans open items with code spans constantly
spec.marxyToday: contradicted — re-run: code span, strong, em and link openers lose the checkbox (from-mdast.ts attachTaskMarker)

spec.default: Summoned marks from a byte-range diff against an in-memory last-seen buffer; not persisted
spec.why: Agents regenerate plans; need inferred, unmeasured
spec.marxyToday: open — offsetThroughEdit (restore.ts) handles one run or several above the reader; an edit below plus one above lands at the common prefix (62 on 03-ai-plan.md, reader at byte 1495)

spec.default: Source stays the default; derived transcript view is summoned, read-only, provenance to the JSONL line
spec.why: Half of a session file is bookkeeping; view must not replace the file

operations.title: Copy one transcript turn exactly
operations.why: Exact source of a turn, from provenance

operations.title: Copy a tool result whole
operations.why: Folding must never cost a byte; copy reads source range not DOM

operations.title: Copy every unchecked task line
operations.why: Carry a plan's remaining work into the next prompt

operations.title: List sanitiser removals with byte ranges
Derive a reading-ordered transcript from JSONL (view only)
operations.why: Session files are half bookkeeping; must skip unknown line types

operations.title: Toggle a task item (v1, blocked for code-span-led items)

gaps.what: Turn, role and tool nodes; a view derived from another file's lines
gaps.detail: ast.ts has no speaker/tool node and every range is in a markdown buffer; contracts are frozen (ADR required)
gaps.proposal: ADR for a view-only turn structure reusing the {file,start,end} range type, keyed to JSONL line ranges

gaps.detail: render-html.ts:127 drops it pending 'the story that designs the document head'; a metadata-head token/class needs registry entries
gaps.proposal: Register a class and tokens for the document head; story to render key/value lines

gaps.what: Keep XML tag children with an inline label instead of removing
gaps.detail: ADR-0009 default-deny removes unknown elements with contents
gaps.proposal: Amend ADR-0009: for unknown non-void elements at the document root, keep children and record the element name as a visible label; scripts/style stay removed

gaps.detail: A notice class and event need registering in scripts/registry.json; shell notices region exists for images only
gaps.proposal: Register a removal-notice class and reuse ensureNoticesRegion

gaps.what: Persisted fold state for authored details
gaps.detail: details is transparent by policy; no state store
gaps.proposal: Decide whether details should be preserved as a semantic block; out of v1 unless the queue asks
